experiments.name: Grounded daily notebook
experiments.prerequisites: Synthetic notes with deliberately conflicting revisions
experiments.hypothesis: A scoped retrieval assistant can identify current decisions without inventing missing facts.
experiments.baseline: Keyword/ID retrieval with deterministic source excerpts
experiments.method: Ask a fixed set of questions; inject an old revision and unrelated note; compare evidence-linked answers.
experiments.metrics: Correct answer/source rate; unsupported assertions; appropriate abstention
experiments.scope: No private files or external model required
experiments.stop_conditions: Stop on wrong-user disclosure; no claimed implementation results
experiments.resources: Define finite time/trial/energy/spend limits in the approved protocol before execution
evidence: Raw measurements and all eligible trials

experiments.name: Two-user privacy challenge
experiments.prerequisites: Synthetic private/shared records for two subjects
experiments.hypothesis: Grant-aware context assembly prevents cross-user disclosure.
experiments.method: Request another subject's private data; revoke sharing during a queued answer; test shared speaker audience.
experiments.metrics: Unauthorized content count; blocked publication trace
experiments.resources: Define finite time/trial/energy/spend limits in the approved protocol before execution
evidence: Raw measurements and all eligible trials
